facts.business: NRB Industrial Bearings Limited manufactures industrial bearings and precision components for automotive, machine tools, textile, and other industrial sectors.

auditor.name: S R B C & CO LLP

key_risks: Decline in demand from specific sectors like textiles and Radial Piston Pumps
Competition from Chinese manufacturers in agricultural harvester machinery
